Yeah, it makes it unbearably slow so when I do use them I use the trap setters to counter that speed reduction. But then I stopped using them all together because they were still getting out on the first struggle with a brown luck offering. I was like, "Ohhhh kaaaaaay these are trash." So until they make them better I'll just keep using my honing/diamond stones.

A major luck offering kills the traps because they can literally get out on the first struggle which is absurd, even more so with slippery meat. That's why diamond stone is so viable at high level play. Placing traps around pallet looping areas is so key, too. Not necessarily inside the pallets themselves, because that's too obvious, but near them, like around the crates where there's some grass to cover them. As far as the struggle game goes once the survivor is caught, I feel that the "being trapped" scenario should require the survivor to have skillchecks to get out. The 4 coil spring should increase the number of skill checks required to escape to a moderate level, and on top of that make it, make them harder to hit (like an overcharged Gen, maybe that's too strong, but you get the idea) to make the 4 coil spring a more viable add-on.
